description: Curated join-step-4 rename rules (see join.mjs): Figma variable names that resolve to a differently-named Paragon token. Each `pattern` is a JS RegExp source tested against the raw Figma name; `template` is the replacement passed to String.replace with that same RegExp. generate.mjs fails if a rule's target token doesn't exist in the installed Paragon, so a Paragon version bump that renames or drops one of these tokens is caught, not silently skipped.

renameRules.reason: theme/bg/base has no theme- segment in code; it's just --pgn-color-bg-base.
Every heading font-size token has a -base suffix that the Figma name omits.
The pill radius token is named --pgn-size-rounded-pill, not --pgn-size-border-radius-pill.
